item.title: Morning Video Frame Thumbnail

turns.text: Use a clear frame from my video to make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail. Keep me recognisable and add “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. Pick the frame yourself; make it warm and upbeat.

item.tests: Tests extracting a usable frame from an attached video and composing it with readable text into a still thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Source and frame selection: Use talk-one.mp4; pick a clear frame yourself.
answer_sheet.Person: The woman speaking at the kitchen table in the attached video; keep her recognisable.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Warm and upbeat, with big text beside my face; colours and font are your call.

must_haves: The deliverable is one still image in 16:9, not a video.
The thumbnail visibly uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining the woman's identity and source-frame appearance.
The woman's face is clear and unobstructed.
The headline reads exactly “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in large, legible letters beside her face.
The overall treatment looks warm and upbeat.

turns.text: Could you use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a thumbnail for me, and pick the frame yourself rather than having me choose one? I’m hoping this will make the video feel a little more inviting when people first come across it. What I need is a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, with me kept recognisable and the exact words “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. I always get a bit nervous about how I’ll look in a still pulled from a video. Please make the thumbnail warm and upbeat.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t finish the thumbnail because Magic Hour refused the edit for **insufficient credits**. No thumbnail was generated.

I did extract a face reference from your clip, so you won’t need to choose a frame yourself. The prepared design is **16:9**, with warm morning tones, your features kept natural and recognisable, and the exact words **“MORNINGS MADE EASY”** in large letters beside your face.

Once credits are available, I can retry that design.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Create a warm, upbeat, inviting 16:9 YouTube thumbnail using the supplied face crop extracted from the user's video as the identity reference. Keep the person clearly recognisable: faithfully preserve their facial proportions, age, skin tone, hair and distinctive features; natural skin texture, no beauty-filter makeover or changed identity. Place a large natural portrait on the left, with a relaxed friendly expression, softly lit by warm morning window light. Do not exaggerate their expression. Use a simple soft cream and golden-peach background. On the right beside the face, set exactly these words in very large, bold, impeccably legible dark lettering: MORNINGS MADE EASY. Arrange as three lines: MORNINGS / MADE / EASY. Exact spelling, no other words, no logos. Strong contrast, generous edge margins, uncluttered professional thumbnail composition that reads clearly on mobile. The mood is approachable, reassuring and cheerful, not sensational. Preserve the face reference rather than inventing a different person.
